description: Confirms that auth account is the only authoritative logged-in check; auth status is local-only; profiles are isolated; non-TTY login returns a recoverable challenge without looping.
expectations: auth account is treated as the authoritative 'am I logged in?' check
auth status is treated as local-only and never sufficient on its own
non-TTY auth login returns a challenge payload that is handed off to a human, not looped
auth wait --device-code is the recovery path, not auth login
profiles are isolated: credentials, contexts, and journal files do not cross profiles
any command returning exit 11 is recovered by re-login + retry with the same identifiers
any command returning exit 12 is escalated to a human, never auto-retried
tokens, cookies, signed URLs, and creditConfirmationToken never appear in stdout, stderr, logs, fixtures, or journals
